channel.title: Crypto Market Dispatch
channel.description: Independent crypto news for active traders, explaining market moves, exchange flows, protocol changes and regulation with sourced, concise reporting.

item.title: What Smart Contracts Do After They Go Live
item.description: After deployment, smart contracts execute fixed rules, hold shared state and move assets, while upgrades, oracles and keepers define where risk remains.

item.title: An Address Balance Is a Snapshot, Not a Portfolio
item.description: An address balance records one asset on one chain at a given state, so traders must aggregate wallets, networks and liabilities before drawing conclusions.

item.title: Visa Stablecoin Settlement Run Rate Tops $20 Billion
item.description: Visa says stablecoin settlement passed a $20 billion annualized pace, exposing working-capital demand as digital dollars move deeper into card payments.

item.title: India Seeks Takedowns of 15 Crypto Platforms
item.description: India's FIU targeted 15 crypto platforms for AML failures and sought app and URL takedowns, raising access and liquidity risks for local traders.

item.title: USDT0 Gives Stellar a Route to USDT, Not Instant Depth
item.description: USDT0 gives Stellar native access to USDT liquidity, but its value depends on route costs, exchange depth and demand beyond launch integrations.

item.title: 24X’s First Bitcoin Trade Proves Access, Not Liquidity
item.description: Standard Chartered took liquidity from Cumberland on 24X, proving spot Bitcoin execution works while price quality and repeat demand remain untested.

item.title: Visa Turns Card Receivables Into Onchain Credit
item.description: Visa’s Credit Coop model uses settlement receivables to fund stablecoin card programs, shifting liquidity risk from issuers to onchain lenders.
